Chat Edit: '5) Extra features you asked for (notes)

Undo/Redo — implemented via @tiptap/extension-history.

Bold / Italic / Underline / Headings / Lists — via StarterKit + Underline.

Tables — via TipTap table extensions (basic insert).

Images — handled via upload → Supabase Storage → inserted with setImage.

Markdown Editor — TipTap can parse/serialize Markdown (requires @tiptap/pm markdown extensions). If you want full markdown mode + preview, I can add a toggle that converts HTML ↔ Markdown using turndown and showdown.

PDF/PPT/DOC — server extracts PDF & DOCX text (above). PPTX extraction can be added (needs pptx-parser or unzip + parse) — I can add it next if you want.

Insert graph — two options:

Generate chart client-side via Chart.js from data and insert as image via canvas.

Accept CSV/table and show an embedded chart component (I can add).

Undo/Redo — included.

Undo/Redo button — included in toolbar.

Attachments (PPT/Word → notes) — server uploads and extracts; I provided extraction for PDF & DOCX.

Insert images button — included.

Bold / bullets / fonts / styles — basic toolbar added. For fonts & styles, TipTap supports custom CSS classes; I can add font family picker.

PDF → notes — server extracts text; Editor inserts it.

PPT → notes — partial support; I can add PPTX extraction if you want.

Word → notes — DOCX extraction via mammoth included.
and fix any error'

", editorProps: { attributes: { class: "prose prose-sm sm:prose lg:prose-lg max-w-none focus:outline-none" }, }, immediatelyRender: false, // <--- add this }); This tells Tiptap not to try rendering on the server, avoiding hydration mismatches. 2️⃣ Wrap editor rendering in a useEffect check Optionally, make sure the editor only renders on the client: ts Copy code const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false); useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []); if (!mounted || !editor) return null; // wait until client Then your EditorContent will render only on the client. '
